data.notes: March 2027 is still early on the announcement cycle, but confirmed listings already mix touring club/venue shows with Black Masking Indian traditions and Hogs for the Cause.

events.title: Hogs for the Cause
events.summary: Hogs for the Cause is confirmed for March 19–20, 2027 as a two-day barbecue and music fundraiser in New Orleans. The 2027 music lineup had not been announced at research time.

events.title: St. Joseph’s Night 2027 Mardi Gras Indian Masking Day
events.summary: Black Masking Indian tribes come out after dark for St. Joseph’s Night, with the listing specifying Uptown and Downtown routes from 6:00 PM to midnight. Expect the tradition's chants, drums, suits, and neighborhood processions rather than a conventional stage lineup.

events.title: Uptown Super Sunday 2027 Mardi Gras Indian Masking Day
events.summary: Daytime Uptown Super Sunday gathering and procession from A.L. Davis Park, one of the city’s core Black Masking Indian culture moments, with vendors, sound trucks and post-procession activity expected along the route.

events.title: Downtown Super Sunday 2027 Mardi Gras Indian Masking Day
events.summary: Downtown/Bayou St. John edition of Super Sunday, bringing Black Masking Indian tribes and neighborhood crowds into a daytime cultural procession rooted in New Orleans street, drum and masking traditions.

events.title: Sylvan Esso
events.summary: Sylvan Esso plays an evening show at Tipitina's, one of New Orleans' key live-music rooms. The venue lists doors at 7:00 PM and showtime at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Death Cab for Cutie w/ Swapmeet
events.summary: Death Cab for Cutie headlines the Saenger Theatre New Orleans with Swapmeet. Ticketmaster lists the show for Friday, March 26 at 7:30 PM.

events.title: Sammy Rae & The Friends - the GET DOWN!
events.summary: Sammy Rae & The Friends bring their GET DOWN! tour to House of Blues New Orleans. The venue calendar lists the show for Sunday, March 14 at 7:00 PM.

events.title: NEEDTOBREATHE: The Long Surrender Tour
events.summary: NEEDTOBREATHE headlines The Fillmore New Orleans on The Long Surrender Tour, with The National Parks appearing on the tour routing. The confirmed Fillmore listing is for 6:00 PM.

events.title: Alaska Thunderf*ck: The Revolution Tour
events.summary: Alaska Thunderf*ck brings The Revolution Tour to House of Blues New Orleans. The venue calendar confirms the event for Friday, March 26 at 7:00 PM.

events.title: Sungazer with Button Masher
events.summary: Sungazer appears at Gasa Gasa with Button Masher for a late-night Freret Street show listed at 9:00 PM.

events.title: MICO - IN:BETWEEN TOUR
events.summary: MICO brings the IN:BETWEEN TOUR to House of Blues New Orleans, with doors listed at 7:00 PM and showtime at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Valencia Grace
events.summary: Valencia Grace plays Gasa Gasa at 9:00 PM, with doors listed at 8:00 PM. The listing describes the artist's sound as modern pop with synth-driven dance production and theatrical elements.
